svg.title: G3 - Ember Cloud
svg.desc: Copper and rose galactic dust against an indigo base, within the unchanged Kosmos download symbol. Preview only.
svg.metadata: Texture: NASA and the Hubble Heritage Team (STScI/AURA); N. Scoville (Caltech), T. Rector (NOAO). PIA04230. Source: https://images-assets.nasa.gov/image/PIA04230/PIA04230~orig.jpg. Artistic crop and recoloring.
